The '''Malachor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Malachor II]], [[Malachor III]], and [[Malachor V]]. It was one of the earliest colonies of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] after their defeat of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Rakatan Infinite Empire]] on the Sith homeworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The victory over the Rakata yielded [[Starship/Legends|starships]] with which the Sith reached new systems such as Malachor. For some reason the system was considered taboo by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] at the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The system was also noted for one of its peculiar oddities, though it was known to only have three planets, the system was filled with mass shadows, more than what could be attributed to three planets, though Malachor V's gravity in particular was also immensely strong, before it was finally destroyed during the [[Dark Wars]].
